title: Hampton's old-fashioned phrasing
summary: Hampton still plays scales with embellishments; Mingus reminds Johnson of a letter.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: (Unintelligible.) It's like, Lionel Hampton has recorded some music, and he's still playing that old-fashioned phrasing.
And it really sound like scales. And some embellishments embedded in the scales.
I wrote you a letter about that.
Where the latest line was -- you
remember that? (Unintelligible) got me playing four-four.
What this suggests to me is Hampton.
You ought to read that letter again.
I got a batch of them somewhere, yeah.
Yeah, you ought to read that letter.
